_register: Formal vykanie (never tykanie) in sentences addressed to the reader, with the polite imperative plural in instructions (Zadajte, Uložte, Naskenujte čiarový kód); buttons and menu entries use the infinitive or a noun (Požičať, Uložiť, Zrušiť, Vrátenie); no jokes, no exclamation marks; masculine generic forms (žiak, učiteľ, čitateľ) are used, no split forms with slashes.
_quotes: Slovak low-high quotes „text“ (U+201E opening, U+201C closing; nested ‚ ‘), no space inside; a non-breaking space (U+00A0) after one-letter prepositions and conjunctions (k, s, v, z, o, u, a, i) and between a number and its unit or % (e.g. 5 %); decimal comma and a no-break space as thousands separator (1 000); dates as 1. 11. 2026 with spaces after the full stops; the arrow → stays.
_plural: Slovak has the forms one (1), few (2–4), many (fractions only) and other (0, 5 and more), so every counted message needs one, few and other at least (e.g. 1 výpožička, 2 výpožičky, 5 výpožičiek), and many where the rules ask for it.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; the standard word in Slovak library software (Clavius, Cosmotron, Koha sk); never « kópia ».

record.note: Bibliographic record, « bibliografický záznam »; the plain form « záznam » is used.

patron.note: The usual word in Slovak libraries and library systems for anyone who borrows; « používateľ » is the formal law term but is also the word for the software user, so it is avoided.

card.note: Usual name of the library card in Slovak libraries; short form « preukaz » where the context is clear.

loan.note: Menu entry for the area: « Výpožičky ». The action of lending: « požičať », « vypožičať » is used for the patron only.

return.note: The action: « Vrátenie » on the menu, « vrátiť » for the verb.

renew.note: Extending the due date; « predĺženie výpožičky » in Slovak libraries. Keep « predĺženie » everywhere.

due date.note: Slovak libraries say « termín vrátenia » or « výpožičná lehota » for the period; the date is « termín vrátenia ».

overdue.note: Short form « po termíne »; the adjective « omeškaný » is used for a loan (« omeškaná výpožička »).

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS), the word used in Slovak libraries.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and signatúra on the spine; « chrbtový štítok » is also used in libraries, but « pásik » keeps it apart from the barcode « štítok ».

label.note: An adhesive label with a barcode; « etiketa » is not used.

barcode.note: Plural « čiarové kódy »; the common word in Slovak software (not « bar kód »).

class.note: A school class (3. B); the class upgrade moves it up.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for; short form « úroveň čítania » is not used so that it always agrees with « čitateľ ».

classification.note: The sorting scheme (MDT, the Slovak form of the Universal Decimal Classification, and Dewey for non-fiction); « triedenie » is used only for sorting a list.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; in Slovak libraries the statutory check is « revízia knižničného fondu », shortened to « revízia »; « inventúra » is the accounting term and is not used here.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « návrhy na nákup » is also used in libraries, but « zoznam želaní » is shorter for a menu entry.

census.note: Registering the čitatelia with their photo; « sčítanie » would mean a population count in Slovak.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; the plain verb « posunúť do vyššieho ročníka » can be used in sentences.

anonymise.note: Noun « anonymizácia »; erasing the personal data for good.

staff account.note: A shared login per role; « účet pracovníka knižnice » when the context needs it.

backup.note: Usual word in Slovak software; the verb « zálohovať ».

restore.note: Verb « obnoviť »; putting a backup back.

colour set.note: A palette of the interface; written « farebná ».

print list.note: A list of patrons or copies to print cards or labels for.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « čítačka » alone is used where the context is clear. « Skener » is also heard, but « čítačka » is the library word and avoids the clash with « čitateľ ».

wizard.note: The first-start sequence of questions, « sprievodca nastavením ».

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with.

student.note: The school library is mostly a primary and lower-secondary one; « žiak » is the term of the Slovak Education Act for pupils of základná škola, « študent » is used only for stredná škola in the strict sense, so « žiak » is chosen for both. Feminine « žiačka » is not used.

teacher.note: Feminine « učiteľka » only where the gender is known; the plain form is « učiteľ ».

administration.note: The area for the administrator; « správa » is not used because it also means « message ».

configuration.note: « Nastavenia » is used for the single settings page.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Výpožičky ».
